scene: You step off the night funicular onto the lively, starlit rooftop.
picture: Flat side view. Along one ground line: on the far left, the open night funicular car sits on its tilted rail; next to it stands a smiling brass cocoa robot holding a tray; the player stands left of centre; in the centre, a glowing tile star map wall shines; on the right, unoccupied deckchairs face right toward a massive mounted rooftop telescope.
shown: A cheerful brass cocoa robot steaming gently on the left.
An illuminated tile star map wall glowing in the centre.
A large mounted observatory telescope pointing skyward on the far right.
